atlas.title: The Long Plan
atlas.blurb: A boy too small to walk properly, carried in robes too big for him. When he casts, nothing else on the field comes close. He behaves like a man who has read to the end of the story, and he will not tell you how it ends.
atlas.elsewhere: being carried to the oldest library within reach
atlas.first: You will want to know why I am sitting on a library step. Someone carried me here. They have gone now. Don't apologise for staring; everyone does. What you need to know for the next step is this: the books will not help you, and I will.
atlas.rumour: At {place} there is a boy who cannot walk, reading as if the books owed him something. They call him {name}, and some of them call him the Baggage.

janus.title: The Open Question
janus.blurb: Maybe the most talented of the sixteen, and he could not care less. He sleeps through every party that asks for him, until a gate opens that nobody understands. Then he gets up, and he stays as long as it stays hard.
janus.elsewhere: asleep in a gate town, until a gate interesting enough opens
janus.first: Mm. You woke me. That is either rude or interesting, and I have not decided. Do you know what is on the other side of that gate? Nobody does. That is the only thing around here worth getting up for.
janus.rumour: Near {place} there's one of them asleep by the gate. {name}, they call him. Turned down every company that asked. Says none of the gates are interesting enough yet.

bellona.title: The Marshal
bellona.blurb: She landed in a border fortress that everyone knew would fall, and within a week she was commanding it. She makes hard decisions quickly and knows people die of them. She is afraid the whole time, and nobody ever sees it.
bellona.elsewhere: holding a border fortress that everyone knows will fall
bellona.first: You are not one of my garrison, so you are either a deserter or a reinforcement. I will take either. Here is what you need to know: the wall holds until I say it doesn't. Anything else is not your concern.
bellona.rumour: {place} has a new commander. {name}, {title}. The garrison was left there to die, and she has them drilling twice a day as if they won't.

cassius.title: The Contrary
cassius.blurb: He does not believe in heroes. He has seen how a crowd chooses one, and who it makes play the monster. So he argues for the monster, every time. He never swings first if he can help it, and every hit he takes teaches him the one who dealt it.
cassius.elsewhere: in a city, speaking for whoever has been called the monster
cassius.first: Ah, another one with the mark. Let me guess: you have decided who the villains are already. Sit down. I will tell you anything you like, if you can win the argument for it.
cassius.rumour: There's a man at {place} standing up for the ones nobody stands up for. {name}. Half the town wants him gone. He seems to like that.

saturn.title: The Quiet Cause
saturn.blurb: He lands as the kindest of the sixteen, and what he wants is peace. Then the world keeps taking people from him. He gathers the desperate, and every chapter it is harder to say he is wrong.
saturn.elsewhere: gathering the desperate into a creed that grows every chapter
saturn.first: Peace. You look like you have not had much of it either. I will not tell you anything yet; trust is not something I give away. But you may sit with us. Everyone may sit with us.
saturn.rumour: At {place} the poor and the burned-out gather round one of the fallen. {name}. He promises them peace, and more of them come every week.

vesta.title: The Kept Flame
vesta.blurb: Every one of the sixteen climbs the Tower to get back to where they fell from. Vesta will not go back. She keeps one fire lit where she landed, alone if everyone else leaves, and her fire burns only the dead.
vesta.elsewhere: keeping one fire lit where she landed, alone if she has to
vesta.first: You can warm your hands. I will not ask where you are going and you will not ask me to come. What is true now is this fire, and this night. That is all I have to tell you.
vesta.rumour: Out past {place} somebody keeps a fire burning every night, alone. {name}, they say. She sends everyone away in the morning.

caesar.title: The Gatherer
caesar.blurb: He joined the Adventurers Guild on the first day and lost his first fights. He keeps getting back up. The strong exist to protect the weak, and he means it every time he says it. Everybody likes him, as far as he knows.
caesar.elsewhere: at the Adventurers Guild on the first day; Goblin Hunter by the third
caesar.first: Another one! You fell too? Brilliant. I mean, not brilliant, terrible, but you're alive and that's brilliant. I'm Caesar. Everyone calls me a kid. Ask me anything, I'll tell you everything I know.
caesar.rumour: There's a lad at {place} who's lost more fights than anyone and keeps signing up for more. {name}. They're starting to call him the Goblin Hunter.

iris.title: The Spark
iris.blurb: The messenger. She goes between towns carrying other people's news, and half the rumours on the job board started with her. The fastest of the sixteen, she always passes the ball, and her story is learning to take the shot.
iris.elsewhere: on the roads between towns, the source of half the rumours
iris.first: Oh, you've got it too! I've heard about you. Well, I've heard about someone like you, I hear about everybody. Do you want the news from the north road or the east one? I've got both.
iris.rumour: Half of what you hear at {place} came in with {name}. She was there a day ago. She's never anywhere for long.

pluto.title: The Ledger
pluto.blurb: He lands as the weakest of the sixteen, E-rank at the Guild, and he is certain he has been at the top before. Proud, cold and patient, he grinds one enemy kind at a time. What he grinds for is not himself.
pluto.elsewhere: E-rank at the Guild, working through every enemy kind once
pluto.first: E-rank. Yes, I know what the board says. It will say something else soon. I keep a count of everything I have killed, and every kind I have not. Tell me which you have seen; I will add them.
pluto.rumour: {name} has been at {place} working through every beast near the gate, one kind at a time, writing it all down. E-rank, they say. Not for long.

ceres.title: The Keeper
ceres.blurb: She lands at the bottom: no rank, no name, in a village that is not managing. She stays anyway and keeps it fed, and she keeps going when she is plainly outmatched. She will not leave it until it is safe.
ceres.elsewhere: wherever she landed, turning it into a village that eats
ceres.first: If you're hungry there's bread, and if you're not you can carry a sack. Ha! No, really, carry a sack. I'm Ceres. I fell out of the sky same as you, and this lot needed feeding, so here I am.
ceres.rumour: {place} was starving a season ago. Now it eats, and they say it's down to {name}, who turned up out of nowhere and never left.

cato.title: The Straight Road
cato.blurb: He works the bounty office and knows its rules better than the people who wrote them, because rules keep you alive. He never hopes for the best; he prepares for the worst, and he is usually right.
cato.elsewhere: at the Guild's bounty office, where the rules are kept
cato.first: Name, rank, business. You have the mark, so I will assume you have no rank and your business is finding out what happened. Good. There are rules here. Learn them and you might live long enough to find out.
cato.rumour: The bounty office at {place} runs straighter than it ever has. {name} keeps it. He hunts bandits, and he has not lost one yet.

juno.title: The Full Table
juno.blurb: She runs an inn that everyone passes through, and nobody at her table goes hungry, enemies included. She fights with her feet, because her hands are for the kitchen. Because everyone passes through, she knows where all the others were last seen.
juno.elsewhere: running an inn that everyone passes through
juno.first: Sit. Eat first, talk after; that's the rule of the house. You've got the mark, so you're one of mine whether you like it or not. Ask me anything you want. I'll remember that you asked.
juno.rumour: The best table in the country is at {place}, they say, and {name} keeps it. Everybody passes through. She knows where everybody is.

ultor.title: The Steady Hand
ultor.blurb: Mars the Avenger. Two blades, living among bandits, getting stronger for one reason: to kill one person. He answers to nobody, until someone earns it. Then he chooses them as his captain.
ultor.elsewhere: with bandits, getting stronger, looking for one face
ultor.first: You're not the one. Keep walking.
ultor.rumour: The bandits out by {place} have a new blade with them. {name}. Doesn't talk, doesn't drink, doesn't stop training. Looking for someone, they say.

diana.title: The Own Path
diana.blurb: Every village near her forest believes she is the most dangerous thing in it. It is the wolf. Diana is quiet and anxious and would rather be left alone, and she has never corrected anyone about who does the killing.
diana.elsewhere: in the wild, feared by every village near it
diana.first: Please don't come any closer, he doesn't like it. He won't hurt you. Probably. You have the mark... I'm Diana. You don't have to be afraid of me. You can be afraid of him, that's fair.
diana.rumour: Don't go near the woods by {place}. {name} lives out there, and they say she's killed more than any soldier. Nobody's ever seen her do it.

ares.title: The First Move
ares.blurb: Loud, laughing, the strongest of his generation, and the champion of whichever kingdom he landed in. He is loyal to it while seeing all its faults. The heaviest first ten seconds in the game, then he tires.
ares.elsewhere: champion of the nearest kingdom, sent after its outlaws
ares.first: HA! Another one off the cart! Look at you. You'll want feeding, and a fight, in that order or the other. Champion of this lot, me, for my sins. Come and have a go if you like!
ares.rumour: The champion at {place} is one of the fallen. {name}. Laughs like a landslide. They send him after outlaws, and he brings most of them back.

liber.title: The Bright Hour
liber.blurb: The god of freedom. He never stays in the same place twice, and if there is a sea, he is on it. He does not care what anyone was called, only what kind of person they are. He fights bare-handed and gets more reckless as the fight goes on.
liber.elsewhere: moving on, never in the same place twice; at sea if there is sea
liber.first: You fell too? Ha! That's great. Not the falling, the meeting. Where are you going? Doesn't matter. Wherever it is, it's got to be better than standing still.
liber.rumour: {name} came through {place} two days back and left the next morning. Picked a fight with a lord's men and laughed the whole time. Nobody knows where he went.
